title: Improve Generalization
goals: Compare training and validation evidence for model capacity
Explain overfitting without assuming every gap proves it
Use a declared selection rule instead of perfect training fit
vocabulary: Flexibility of a model to represent patterns
Learning details that fail to generalize well

blocks.title: Overfitting and model capacity at a glance
blocks.caption: The curve result is consistent with overfitting, but a gap alone does not prove its cause. A changed population, bad labels or a split error could also produce a gap. Inspect the procedure before claiming a diagnosis. The constant may miss useful structure, but these numbers alone do not identify the true relationship.

blocks.label: Does a training-validation gap alone prove overfitting? Explain the steps or evidence behind your response.

guided_practice.title: Interpret a gap
guided_practice.prompt: Does a training-validation gap alone prove overfitting?
guided_practice.answer: Teacher explanation: No. It is consistent with overfitting but may also reflect shift, data quality or split problems.

independent_case.title: Changed independent case
independent_case.task: Spotted leaves have blue backgrounds and healthy leaves white backgrounds in training. Design a generalisation investigation with fresh evaluation.
independent_case.answer: Cross background and class conditions; compare the same leaf on changed backgrounds as a diagnostic and group views by plant in splits. Use development data for decisions, then compare frozen versions on the same untouched final records. Record actual outcomes; the correlated backgrounds alone do not prove a shortcut.

misconceptions: Ask for the relevant counts, units, procedure or saved record. For this week: Choose the line with validation MAE 3. The curve training MAE 0 does not compensate for validation MAE 8.
A stronger claim makes a stronger project

blocks.text: ML MECHANISM
Input → Model → Evidence
Trace the information, fitted behavior, and evaluation proof separately.
QUESTION  Choose one controlled repair and rerun the same evaluation.
MODEL IDEA  Different failure causes require different repairs: simplicity, representative data, regularization, or better features.
PROOF NEEDED  Use an unseen case, visible calculation, error analysis, and a stated limitation.
UNDER THE HOOD  Evidence: high train score, low validation score, largest gap in low light. Hypothesis combines complexity and missing low-light coverage; choose one cause to test first.
Draw a fresh data → model → prediction → evaluation trace:
A closer explanation

On the same regression split, a constant has training MAE 5 and validation 6, a line has training 2 and validation 3, and a highly flexible curve has training 0 and validation 8. Under smallest validation MAE, choose the line. The curve has the lowest training loss but the worst validation result.

Apply the connected idea: Distribution shift

On development-like bright images, a frozen classroom classifier makes 2 errors in 20 cases:10 percent. On a separate dim set it makes 6 errors in 20:30 percent. The pooled result is 8/40=20 percent error. The pooled score hides a 20-percentage-point difference between conditions.

EVALUATION DESIGN
Four Tests, Four Kinds of Evidence
A system is not understood until it survives more than one comfortable example.
NORMAL  Expected data and expected behavior.
BOUNDARY  Value close to a threshold, ambiguous label, or uncertain prediction.
MISSING  Necessary field, label, source, or measurement is unavailable.
SHIFTED  New lighting, species, device, subgroup, or time condition.
RELEASE RULE  Passing one case never proves generalization. Predefine expected behavior for all four categories.
